description: Use this before an agent or wallet signs a Solana transaction. Decodes the unsigned or signed transaction and returns NO_MATCH (no known-bad pattern matched; not a safety guarantee), WARN, or BLOCK, with plain-language reasons and a signed receipt. Pass an x402 quote to also check a payment transaction against it (overpay, approve-instead-of-transfer, unchecked Transfer, wrong payee). Errors return ERROR and are never charged. Price $0.009 USDC (x402, Solana).

cap_base_units.description: Hard per-payment cap enforced even if the quote asks for more.

caps.description: Optional spend caps you declare; any violation returns BLOCK. Keys: max_amount (int base units per outflow), max_amounts ({mint|'SOL': int}), max_total (int per asset), allowed_payees ([pubkey]; owners' ATAs match), allowed_assets ([mint|'SOL']), allow_approvals (bool, default false).

known_addresses.description: Optional: pubkeys you have recently paid or received from. A recipient that only looks like one of these (same first/last characters) is flagged as address poisoning.

quote.description: x402 quote the tx pays: {asset, amount, pay_to | pay_to_token_account, decimals?, token_program?}.

simulate.description: Simulate against Solana mainnet (Helius RPC, sigVerify off, recent blockhash replaced, never submitted). Default true; false = static checks only. If simulation fails the verdict is at least WARN, except plain System/Token/ATA/ComputeBudget/Memo transactions with no unresolved lookup tables, which are fully decoded statically. Third-party unlimited approvals BLOCK by default. Response includes risk_score (0-100), basis (simulated|static) and top_reason.

strict.description: Escalate HIGH-risk token approvals (unlimited or third-party delegate) from WARN to BLOCK. Default false.

tx.description: Base64 wire transaction (also accepts an RPC getTransaction result).

wallet.description: Your own pubkey; only this key is treated as 'you'.

name: shield_guard_check
title: Falcon Shield: check a Solana tx before signing
